title: Summary Analysis of Responses to the Request for Information Regarding Security Considerations for AI Agents
attributed_claim_summary: NIST summarized external responses to an AI-agent-security RFI; respondents described agent-specific threat concerns and called for adapted security practices and implementation guidance.
evidence_or_event: Original NIST Trustworthy and Responsible AI 800-5 report dated May 18, 2026; a compilation and analysis of stakeholder comments.
limitations: Stakeholder submissions are not a measured prevalence sample, an RCT or product-level security certification; a consensus on concerns is not a verified incident frequency.
research_relevance: Turn security claims into isolated negative tests of authority boundaries, source trust, tool misuse and human approval for irreversible agent actions.
practical_experiment: Construct a synthetic least-privilege tool-agent harness with benign unauthorized-action cases, count policy denials and accepted safe tasks without accessing real credentials.
